definitions.explanation: The pair of small strokes written at the upper right of a kana to mark a voiced consonant, as in が, ざ, だ, and ば.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濁点|だくてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{間違|まちが}え→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Children easily misread characters that have a dakuten.

examples.japanese: {濁点|だくてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{清音|せいおん}→清音：23458_seion⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{濁音|だくおん}→濁音：19295_dakuon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦{記号|きごう}→記号：00224_kigou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、かな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{右上|みぎうえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The dakuten is a mark that turns a voiceless sound into a voiced one, written small at the upper right of a kana.

notes:
The voicing mark written at the upper right of a kana to indicate a voiced consonant: ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ becomes が, さ becomes ざ, た becomes だ, ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ becomes ば. Colloquially called ⟦{点々|てんてん}→点々：03974_tenten⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {濁点|だくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to add a dakuten
- {濁点|だくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とる: to remove a dakuten
- {濁点|だくてん}つき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧: a character with a dakuten

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {半濁点|はんだくてん}: handakuten — the small circle that turns ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ into ぱ
- ⟦{濁音|だくおん}→濁音：19295_dakuon⟧: voiced sound — the voiced syllable itself, the result of adding a {濁点|だくてん}
